scenarios.expected: Links reach the intended records; Tasks remain distinct from deadline surfaces; ? opens shortcuts. Empty sections and unavailable records have useful outcomes; / and Escape retain their existing behavior.
scenarios.actual: 14 recorded Administrator steps passed. Home showed Inbox > Entity obligations > Tasks assigned to you > Dates approaching > Your contracts > Your matters, which is the documented order (no pending Approvals, so that card was omitted), and no empty section. The fixture Task on Tasks assigned to you opened C-187 with its number and title; Fields and Documents opened and Home returned. Inbox: the card said View all 19 while the database held 12 New and 7 Read Requests. Fixture R-70 was New, opening it from the Inbox list made it Read, and it stayed on Home's count and the Inbox list. Your contracts and Your matters rows all had Daniel as Owner or Matter Manager. The fixture Task's due date was absent from Dates approaching, and View all opened Your dates. ? opened Keyboard shortcuts and Escape closed it and the name menu. / focused Search, and ? and / typed in the box stayed there. After one search the empty box opened a Recent group and Advanced search…, Escape closed it, and the Recent entry ran the search. With a saved search the fresh Administrator saw Saved and Recent groups, and the saved entry ran at once. Tab moved focus, and Enter opened Contracts. Help found this guide and no record. C-999999 and M-999999 showed Contract not found and Matter not found with the does-not-exist-or-cannot-open sentence and working Back to Contracts and Back to Matters links. Entity obligations for the fresh Administrator with a Grant listed the Unassigned Obligation (marked Unassigned, Overdue) and the Confidential Entity Obligation whose Administrator assignee has no Grant, overdue first. It left out the Obligation assigned to a Legal Team Member who can reach the Entity, and a row opened the Entity's Obligations. The Administrator assignee without a Grant and Daniel (no Grant) did not see that Confidential Entity Obligation but did see the Unassigned one. Your Tasks for the fresh Administrator: No open Tasks assigned to you. with no Home Tasks card at first. With 55 Tasks, View all 55 opened Your Tasks with 50 rows, and Load more Tasks gave 55 in due-date order with the two undated last. Completing showed Completed with Undo, and Undo reopened. Show completed listed the completed Task and read Hide completed. Clearing its control showed Reopened. A Task title opened C-187, and Home returned.
